subject: Environment accession & network stabilization checklist — ACME Health edge deployment
messages:
From: Alex Diaz <alex.diaz@acmehealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: netops@acmehealth.com
Date: 2028-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME edge onboarding — initial checklist request

Hi Rishi,

We’re lining up the private deployment for the edge site (site-id: ACME-EDGE-3) and need Redwood’s onboarding checklist so we can map responsibilities on our side. High level we care about:
- Network & firewall rules (ingress/egress)
- Service account & IAM provisioning
- KMS / key escrow expectations
- Smoke test plan and sample traffic
- Evidence list for our security team (audit logs, retention windows)

Can you send the baseline checklist and any templates (matrix or schematic) we should fill out? Ideally by EOD tomorrow; Natalie (cc) will coordinate netops.

Thanks,
Alex Diaz
Senior Cloud Engineer — ACME Health

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Alex Diaz <alex.diaz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME edge onboarding — initial checklist request

Thanks Alex — sending a working checklist and an activation matrix as attachments. Summary below; see attached env-activation-matrix.xlsx for responsibility columns and a simple completion tracker.

Summary checklist (high level):
1) Account & identities
   - Redwood service account (RBAC) created: yes/no
   - Customer-managed service account for cross-account access: yes/no
   - Recommended roles: compute.viewer, network.viewer, kms.viewer
2) Network & firewall
   - CIDR allocations verified
   - Interconnect / peering IPs configured
   - Firewall allowlist: 443/8443 outbound, 9411 telemetry (customer-specific)
   - BGP/ASN details captured
3) Keys & encryption
   - KMS key ARN shared + rotation policy
   - HSM or KMS integration notes (if required)
4) Telemetry & evidence
   - Audit log retention (30/90/365 days)
   - Export path for logs (S3/GCS)
5) Preflight tests
   - Small sample traffic: 50 concurrent rps for 10 minutes
   - KV cache warming plan
6) Cutover & rollback
   - Canary window + fallback plan

Action: please complete the matrix for each item (owner/date/status). I’ll coordinate the smoke run with Ben once netops confirms firewall rules. Attaching: env-activation-matrix.xlsx and a short ACME network schema.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: env-activation-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), acme-network-schema-v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Diaz <alex.diaz@acmehealth.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: netops@acmehealth.com
Date: 2028-09-10T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME edge onboarding — initial checklist request

Adding a couple of technical clarifications for the firewall and routing section (copied into the matrix too):
- Ingress: customer will not open inbound ports to Redwood; all calls are outbound over TLS to our ingress IPs. We will provide a short-lived fqdn and IP list for canary.
- Egress: allow outbound 443 and DNS (53/UDP) from the workload subnet. If you use an HTTP proxy, please include proxy hostname in matrix.
- Health checks: allow our health-check IPs on 8443 (mutual TLS) for readiness probes.
- MTU: if you are peering over VPN, please confirm MTU >= 1400 to avoid fragmentation for large embeddings payloads.

Small ask: can netops export a stripped-down BGP snippet (local ASN, neighbor ASN, prefixes) into the shared Drive link? That speeds validation.

Thanks — I’ll hold the smoke-run slot pending confirmation.

Ben Carter
Onboarding Lead — Redwood Dedicated

From: Natalie Park <natalie.park@acmehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Alex Diaz <alex.diaz@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-11T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME edge onboarding — initial checklist request

Thanks team — attaching the BGP snippet and a short list of our perimeter firewall owners. Two notes from netops: 
- We need the full IP list for telemetry sinks (9411) and our SIEM instance to be whitelisted; currently only domain names were provided.
- For KMS: our policy requires that third-party vendors support key encryption using a customer-managed key in our KMS; can Redwood confirm compatibility with a customer-KMS key?

I’ve uploaded the BGP snippet to the Drive: https://drive.acmehealth/internal/ACME-EDGE-3/network/BGP-snippet.txt

—Natalie
Network Engineering Lead — ACME Health
